title: Janus Henderson CEO on Going Private, M&A Deals
text: Janus Henderson CEO Ali Dibadj said the firm is energized by its move to private ownership and is using the flexibility to invest in people, technology including AI, new products and client service. He said quarterly earnings pressures had constrained those investments, despite the firm’s growth as a public company. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
